My sincere thanks to @BowdoinCollege &  @Tyler_A_Harper for a really enjoyable conversation and evening. 

Also, it’s time for Maine to get some leaves on the trees. It’s mid April already.

“Good morning. It’s Friday. Thumb guy is missing still. And they’re not letting me go to the park because my limp is back. What’s up with that? Also, I love you.”

[archival]

We mustn’t increase … competition at America’s most elite schools because why?




Steve McGuire (@sfmcguire79)

79% of grades at Yale are A-range.

Graduating summa cum laude requires a record high GPA OF 3.98.





— https://nitter.net/sfmcguire79/status/2041921337451487529#m

I honestly don’t get this 25th amendment thing. I coulda sworn the process has to start with the VP/cabinet. I keep hearing congressional Democrats talking about “invoking” the 25th amendment. Has strong “I don’t want to say ‘impeachment’” vibes. Also some Michael Scott vibes

  



Michael Kruse (@michaelkruse)

A centrist House Democrat to @Axios about any 25th Amendment efforts: "I personally think it's a fool's errand." tinyurl.com/4nv9ssz7




— https://nitter.net/michaelkruse/status/204221

It is amazing how he can say this crap with a straight face.


Republicans against Trump (@RpsAgainstTrump)

Vance: “You should never have a foreign head of state threatening the head of government of an allied nation. It's preposterous, it's unacceptable.”

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/RpsAgainstTrump/status/2042087842973642844#m
This high school principal shouldn’t pay for his own meals or beers for a very long time. Can’t imagine the gratitude of the parents. koco.com/article/pauls-valle…

Coming soon to a blue state near you.

  



KOMO News (@komonews)

Across the country, at least ten states, including Washington, are now exploring or have already passed an exit or wealth tax to combat revenue losses from residents fleeing to lower tax areas

komonews.com/news/nation-wor…




— https://nitter.net/komonews/status/2041848645444596206#m

Marvin Wolfgang weeps.


Crémieux (@cremieuxrecueil)

In 2021, 70% of D.C.'s prolific gun violence was done by about 500 people.

That's about 0.075% of the D.C. population at the time.

That's basically nobody and they gave the national capital a bad reputation, and they were KNOWN TO THE POLICE!





— https://nitter.net/cremieuxrecueil/status/2041928705929326676#m

“Hello. It’s Thursday. Thumbguy took out the luggage and left this morning. I will wait here in silent protest until he returns. Or, until nap time. But the protest will remain in my heart. Also, I love you.”
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
